item.title: Fresh release notes here! 📣📰
item.dc:creator: MetaVRDevs
item.content:encoded:
Fresh release notes here! 📣📰
The latest updates give you more detailed camera input and clearer hand-gesture debugging, with fixes that cut per-frame allocations. Our weekly release-note roundup starts with November highlights.
See the full release notes 👉 https://developers.meta.com/vr/release-notes/?utm_source=social-x&utm_medium=MVRD&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=releasenotes
Explore highlights below 🧵
2/ Passthrough Camera API 📷
Mixed Reality Utility Kit (MRUK) v209 adds 1728×1728 camera input on Quest 3/3S with OS v209, plus dynamic capture metadata. This gives computer-vision features more image detail.
Explore MRUK 👉 https://developers.meta.com/vr/downloads/package/meta-xr-mr-utility-kit-upm/?utm_source=social-x&utm_medium=MVRD&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=releasenotes
3/ Interaction SDK 🖐️
Now you can see pinch strength and gesture states while testing hand input. The new DebugInputView overlay shows OS-provided pinch and microgesture states and logs.
See what’s new with Interaction SDK 👉 https://developers.meta.com/vr/downloads/package/meta-xr-interaction-sdk-ovr-integration/?utm_source=social-x&utm_medium=MVRD&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=releasenotes
4/ FOV Simulator 👓
Keep essential UI in view on Meta VR Glasses. Core SDK adds a design-area guideline in OVRManager and Immersive Debugger, so you can check placement in Unity before hardware ships.
Try FOV simulation 👉 https://developers.meta.com/vr/downloads/package/meta-xr-core-sdk/?utm_source=social-x&utm_medium=MVRD&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=releasenotes
5/ Platform SDK 🛠️
Provider initialization now runs off the startup path, reducing 'app not responding' events. This update also fixes Group Presence result mix-ups and large-response failures.
Review platform updates 👉 https://developers.meta.com/vr/downloads/package/meta-xr-platform-sdk/?utm_source=social-x&utm_medium=MVRD&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=releasenotes

item.title: Landing Party is the world's first outdoor roleplaying video game, for XREAL on Android XR, and with multiplayer action
item.dc:creator: XREAL_Global
item.content:encoded: Landing Party is the world's first outdoor roleplaying video game, for XREAL on Android XR, and with multiplayer action on Android phones and iPhones. Called the “next big leap after Pokémon Go”, its 8 patents lay a 3D game world across a real-world space, indoors or outdoors, which you physically walk through to explore. Founder Johnny Monsarrat previously co-invented MMO gaming as Founder & CEO of Turbine (Asheron's Call, Lord of the Rings Online). It's an “Atari moment”, when a new video game platform is born, when outdoor play joins PC, console, mobile, and VR. Press kit and more at http://monsarrat.com/presskit. #XREAL #AURA #Laningparty #AndroidXR Android XR is a trademark of Google LLC. https://x.com/XREAL_Global/status/2120955605384884580/video/1

item.title: We want to clear something up about VRChat Public Instance Ownership! Added two new sections to that part of the Dev Upd
item.dc:creator: VRChat
item.content:encoded:
We want to clear something up about VRChat Public Instance Ownership! Added two new sections to that part of the Dev Update.
TL;DR: The moderation abilities given to the original instance owner DO NOT transfer to other users in an instance when the original instance owner leaves.

item.title: Why should only the surgeon have a 3D view of the operation?
item.dc:creator: XREAL_Global
item.content:encoded:
Why should only the surgeon have a 3D view of the operation?
At Vanderbilt University Medical Center, head and neck cancer surgeon Dr. Michael Topf is using XREAL AURA and apoQlar's HoloMedicine® platform to bring stereoscopic surgical views to more members of the operating room team.
With HoloMedicine Robotics, additional team members can see the surgeon's perspective. And with Shared Experience, surgeons, radiologists, oncologists and pathologists can explore the same 3D medical model together, in real time.
From surgical collaboration to medical education, spatial computing is changing how medical teams visualize, share and understand complex anatomy.
#XREAL #AURA #AndroidXR
